.
=== help share
NAME:
  @PROG@ share - generate URL for temporary access to an object

USAGE:
  @PROG@ share COMMAND [COMMAND FLAGS | -h] [ARGUMENTS...]

COMMANDS:
  download  generate URLs for download access
  upload    generate `curl` command to upload objects without requiring access/secret keys
  list, ls  list previously shared objects
  
FLAGS:
  --config-dir value, -C value     path to configuration folder (default: "@CONFIG_DIR@") [$MC_CONFIG_DIR]
  --quiet, -q                      disable progress bar display [$MC_QUIET]
  --disable-pager, --dp            disable mc internal pager and print to raw stdout [$MC_DISABLE_PAGER]
  --no-color                       disable color theme [$MC_NO_COLOR]
  --json                           enable JSON lines formatted output [$MC_JSON]
  --debug                          enable debug output [$MC_DEBUG]
  --resolve value                  resolves HOST[:PORT] to an IP address. Example: minio.local:9000=10.10.75.1 [$MC_RESOLVE]
  --insecure                       disable SSL certificate verification [$MC_INSECURE]
  --limit-upload value             limits uploads to a maximum rate in KiB/s, MiB/s, GiB/s. (default: unlimited) [$MC_LIMIT_UPLOAD]
  --limit-download value           limits downloads to a maximum rate in KiB/s, MiB/s, GiB/s. (default: unlimited) [$MC_LIMIT_DOWNLOAD]
  --custom-header value, -H value  add custom HTTP header to the request. 'key:value' format.
  --help, -h                       show help
  

=== flags share download
--recursive, -r                  share all objects recursively
--version-id value, --vid value  share a particular object version
--expire value, -E value         set expiry in NN[h|m|s] (default: "168h")
--config-dir value, -C value     path to configuration folder (default: "@CONFIG_DIR@") [$MC_CONFIG_DIR]
--quiet, -q                      disable progress bar display [$MC_QUIET]
--disable-pager, --dp            disable mc internal pager and print to raw stdout [$MC_DISABLE_PAGER]
--no-color                       disable color theme [$MC_NO_COLOR]
--json                           enable JSON lines formatted output [$MC_JSON]
--debug                          enable debug output [$MC_DEBUG]
--resolve value                  resolves HOST[:PORT] to an IP address. Example: minio.local:9000=10.10.75.1 [$MC_RESOLVE]
--insecure                       disable SSL certificate verification [$MC_INSECURE]
--limit-upload value             limits uploads to a maximum rate in KiB/s, MiB/s, GiB/s. (default: unlimited) [$MC_LIMIT_UPLOAD]
--limit-download value           limits downloads to a maximum rate in KiB/s, MiB/s, GiB/s. (default: unlimited) [$MC_LIMIT_DOWNLOAD]
--custom-header value, -H value  add custom HTTP header to the request. 'key:value' format.
--help, -h                       show help
=== help share download
NAME:
  @PROG@ share download - generate URLs for download access

USAGE:
  @PROG@ share download [FLAGS] TARGET [TARGET...]

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
EXAMPLES:
  1. Share this object with 7 days default expiry.
     $ @PROG@ share download s3/backup/2006-Mar-1/backup.tar.gz

  2. Share this object with 10 minutes expiry.
     $ @PROG@ share download --expire=10m s3/backup/2006-Mar-1/backup.tar.gz

  3. Share all objects under this folder with 5 days expiry.
     $ @PROG@ share download --expire=120h s3/backup/2006-Mar-1/

  4. Share all objects under this bucket and all its folders and sub-folders with 5 days expiry.
     $ @PROG@ share download --recursive --expire=120h s3/backup/

=== flags share upload
--recursive, -r                  recursively upload any object matching the prefix
--expire value, -E value         set expiry in NN[h|m|s] (default: "168h")
--content-type value, -T value   specify a content-type to allow
--config-dir value, -C value     path to configuration folder (default: "@CONFIG_DIR@") [$MC_CONFIG_DIR]
--quiet, -q                      disable progress bar display [$MC_QUIET]
--disable-pager, --dp            disable mc internal pager and print to raw stdout [$MC_DISABLE_PAGER]
--no-color                       disable color theme [$MC_NO_COLOR]
--json                           enable JSON lines formatted output [$MC_JSON]
--debug                          enable debug output [$MC_DEBUG]
--resolve value                  resolves HOST[:PORT] to an IP address. Example: minio.local:9000=10.10.75.1 [$MC_RESOLVE]
--insecure                       disable SSL certificate verification [$MC_INSECURE]
--limit-upload value             limits uploads to a maximum rate in KiB/s, MiB/s, GiB/s. (default: unlimited) [$MC_LIMIT_UPLOAD]
--limit-download value           limits downloads to a maximum rate in KiB/s, MiB/s, GiB/s. (default: unlimited) [$MC_LIMIT_DOWNLOAD]
--custom-header value, -H value  add custom HTTP header to the request. 'key:value' format.
--help, -h                       show help
=== help share upload
NAME:
  @PROG@ share upload - generate `curl` command to upload objects without requiring access/secret keys

USAGE:
  @PROG@ share upload [FLAGS] TARGET [TARGET...]

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
EXAMPLES:
  1. Generate a curl command to allow upload access for a single object. Command expires in 7 days (default).
     $ @PROG@ share upload s3/backup/2006-Mar-1/backup.tar.gz

  2. Generate a curl command to allow upload access to a folder. Command expires in 120 hours.
     $ @PROG@ share upload --expire=120h s3/backup/2007-Mar-2/

  3. Generate a curl command to allow upload access of only '.png' images to a folder. Command expires in 2 hours.
     $ @PROG@ share upload --expire=2h --content-type=image/png s3/backup/2007-Mar-2/

  4. Generate a curl command to allow upload access to any objects matching the key prefix 'backup/'. Command expires in 2 hours.
     $ @PROG@ share upload --recursive --expire=2h s3/backup/2007-Mar-2/backup/

=== flags share list
--config-dir value, -C value     path to configuration folder (default: "@CONFIG_DIR@") [$MC_CONFIG_DIR]
--quiet, -q                      disable progress bar display [$MC_QUIET]
--disable-pager, --dp            disable mc internal pager and print to raw stdout [$MC_DISABLE_PAGER]
--no-color                       disable color theme [$MC_NO_COLOR]
--json                           enable JSON lines formatted output [$MC_JSON]
--debug                          enable debug output [$MC_DEBUG]
--resolve value                  resolves HOST[:PORT] to an IP address. Example: minio.local:9000=10.10.75.1 [$MC_RESOLVE]
--insecure                       disable SSL certificate verification [$MC_INSECURE]
--limit-upload value             limits uploads to a maximum rate in KiB/s, MiB/s, GiB/s. (default: unlimited) [$MC_LIMIT_UPLOAD]
--limit-download value           limits downloads to a maximum rate in KiB/s, MiB/s, GiB/s. (default: unlimited) [$MC_LIMIT_DOWNLOAD]
--custom-header value, -H value  add custom HTTP header to the request. 'key:value' format.
--help, -h                       show help
=== help share list
NAME:
  @PROG@ share list COMMAND - list previously shared objects

USAGE:
  @PROG@ share list COMMAND

COMMAND:
  upload:   list previously shared access to uploads.
  download: list previously shared access to downloads.

EXAMPLES:
  1. List previously shared downloads, that haven't expired yet.
      $ @PROG@ share list download

  2. List previously shared uploads, that haven't expired yet.
      $ @PROG@ share list upload

=== help tree
NAME:
  @PROG@ tree - list buckets and objects in a tree format

USAGE:
  @PROG@ tree [FLAGS] TARGET [TARGET ...]

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
EXAMPLES:
   1. List all buckets and directories on MinIO object storage server in tree format.
      $ @PROG@ tree myminio

   2. List all directories in "mybucket" on MinIO object storage server in tree format.
      $ @PROG@ tree myminio/mybucket/

   3. List all directories in "mybucket" on MinIO object storage server hosted on Microsoft Windows in tree format.
      $ @PROG@ tree myminio\mybucket\

   4. List all directories and objects in "mybucket" on MinIO object storage server in tree format.
      $ @PROG@ tree --files myminio/mybucket/

   5. List all directories upto depth level '2' in tree format.
      $ @PROG@ tree --depth 2 myminio/mybucket/

=== help tag list
NAME:
  @PROG@ tag list - list tags of a bucket or an object

USAGE:
  @PROG@ tag list [COMMAND FLAGS] TARGET

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
DESCRIPTION:
   List tags assigned to a bucket or an object

EXAMPLES:
  1. List the tags assigned to an object.
     $ @PROG@ tag list myminio/testbucket/testobject

  2. List the tags assigned to particular version of an object.
     $ @PROG@ tag list --version-id "ieQq7aXsyhlhDt47YURGlrucYY3GxWHa" myminio/testbucket/testobject

  3. List the tags assigned to an object versions that are older than one week.
     $ @PROG@ tag list --versions --rewind 7d myminio/testbucket/testobject

  4. List the tags assigned to an object in JSON format.
     $ @PROG@ tag list --json myminio/testbucket/testobject

  5. List the tags assigned to a bucket.
     $ @PROG@ tag list myminio/testbucket

  6. List the tags assigned to a bucket in JSON format.
     $ @PROG@ tag list --json s3/testbucket

  7. List the tags recursively for all the objects of subdirs of bucket.
     $ @PROG@ tag list --recursive myminio/testbucket

  8. Show the tags recursively for all versions of all objects of subdirs of bucket.
     $ @PROG@ tag list --recursive --versions myminio/testbucket

NAME:
  @PROG@ tag remove - remove tags assigned to a bucket or an object

USAGE:
  @PROG@ tag remove [COMMAND FLAGS] TARGET

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
DESCRIPTION:
  Remove tags assigned to a bucket or an object.

EXAMPLES:
  1. Remove the tags assigned to an object.
     $ @PROG@ tag remove myminio/testbucket/testobject

  2. Remove the tags assigned to a particular version of an object.
     $ @PROG@ tag remove --version-id "ieQq7aXsyhlhDt47YURGlrucYY3GxWHa" myminio/testbucket/testobject

  3. Remove the tags assigned to an object versions that are older than one week
     $ @PROG@ tag remove --versions --rewind 7d myminio/testbucket/testobject

  4. Remove the tags assigned to a bucket.
     $ @PROG@ tag remove play/testbucket

  5. Remove the tags recursively for all the objects of subdirs of bucket.
     $ @PROG@ tag remove --recursive myminio/testbucket

  6. Remove the tags recursively for all versions of all objects of subdirs of bucket.
     $ @PROG@ tag remove --recursive --versions myminio/testbucket

=== help tag set
NAME:
  @PROG@ tag set - set tags for a bucket and object(s)

USAGE:
  @PROG@ tag set [COMMAND FLAGS] TARGET TAGS

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
DESCRIPTION:
   Assign tags to a bucket or an object.

EXAMPLES:
  1. Assign tags to an object.
     $ @PROG@ tag set play/testbucket/testobject "key1=value1&key2=value2&key3=value3"

  2. Assign tags to a particuler version of an object.
     $ @PROG@ tag set --version-id "ieQq7aXsyhlhDt47YURGlrucYY3GxWHa" play/testbucket/testobject "key1=value1&key2=value2&key3=value3"

  3. Assign tags to a object versions older than one week.
     $ @PROG@ tag set --versions --rewind 7d play/testbucket/testobject "key1=value1&key2=value2&key3=value3"

  4. Assign tags to a bucket.
     $ @PROG@ tag set myminio/testbucket "key1=value1&key2=value2&key3=value3"

  5. Assign tags recursively to all the objects of subdirs of bucket.
     $ @PROG@ tag set myminio/testbucket --recursive "key1=value1&key2=value2&key3=value3"

  6. Assign tags recursively to all versions of all objects of subdirs of bucket.
     $ @PROG@ tag set myminio/testbucket --recursive --versions "key1=value1&key2=value2&key3=value3"

  7. Assign tags to all the objects on a bucket, excluding folders
     $ @PROG@ tag set myminio/testbucket --exclude-folders --recursive "key1=value1&key2=value2&key3=value3"

=== help undo
NAME:
  @PROG@ undo - undo PUT/DELETE operations

USAGE:
  @PROG@ undo [FLAGS] TARGET

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
EXAMPLES:
  1. Undo the last 3 uploads and/or removals of a particular object
     $ @PROG@ undo s3/backups/file.zip --last 3

  2. Undo the last upload/removal change of all objects under a prefix
     $ @PROG@ undo s3/backups/prefix/ --recursive --force

=== flags update

Name:
   @PROG@ update - update mc to latest release

USAGE:
   @PROG@ update [FLAGS]

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
EXIT STATUS:
  0 - you are already running the most recent version
  1 - new update was applied successfully
 -1 - error in getting update information

EXAMPLES:
  1. Check and update mc:
     $ @PROG@ update

=== help version enable
NAME:
  @PROG@ version enable - enable bucket versioning

USAGE:
  @PROG@ version enable ALIAS/BUCKET

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
EXAMPLES:
  1. Enable versioning on bucket "mybucket" for alias "myminio".
     $ @PROG@ version enable myminio/mybucket

  2. Enable versioning on bucket "mybucket" while excluding versioning on a few select prefixes.
     $ @PROG@ version enable myminio/mybucket --excluded-prefixes "app1/*/_temporary/,app2/*/_staging/"

  3. Enable versioning on bucket "mybucket" while excluding versioning on a few select prefixes and all folders.
     Note: this is useful on buckets used with Spark/Hadoop workloads.
     $ @PROG@ version enable myminio/mybucket --excluded-prefixes "app1/*/_temporary/,app2/*/_staging/" --exclude-folders

=== help watch
NAME:
  @PROG@ watch - listen for object notification events

USAGE:
  @PROG@ watch [FLAGS] TARGET

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
EXAMPLES:
  1. Watch new S3 operations on a MinIO server
     $ @PROG@ watch play/testbucket

  2. Watch new events for a specific prefix "output/"  on MinIO server.
     $ @PROG@ watch --prefix "output/" play/testbucket

  3. Watch new events for a specific suffix ".jpg" on MinIO server.
     $ @PROG@ watch --suffix ".jpg" play/testbucket

  4. Watch new events on a specific prefix and suffix on MinIO server.
     $ @PROG@ watch --suffix ".jpg" --prefix "photos/" play/testbucket

  5. Site level watch (except new buckets created after running this command)
     $ @PROG@ watch play/

  6. Watch for events on local directory.
     $ @PROG@ watch /usr/share

=== help anonymous set
Name:
  @PROG@ anonymous - manage anonymous access to buckets and objects

USAGE:
  @PROG@ anonymous [FLAGS] set PERMISSION TARGET
  @PROG@ anonymous [FLAGS] set-json FILE TARGET
  @PROG@ anonymous [FLAGS] get TARGET
  @PROG@ anonymous [FLAGS] get-json TARGET
  @PROG@ anonymous [FLAGS] list TARGET

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
PERMISSION:
  Allowed policies are: [private, public, download, upload].

FILE:
  A valid S3 anonymous JSON filepath.

EXAMPLES:
  1. Set bucket to "download" on Amazon S3 cloud storage.
     $ @PROG@ anonymous set download s3/mybucket

  2. Set bucket to "public" on Amazon S3 cloud storage.
     $ @PROG@ anonymous set public s3/shared

  3. Set bucket to "upload" on Amazon S3 cloud storage.
     $ @PROG@ anonymous set upload s3/incoming

  4. Set anonymous to "public" for bucket with prefix on Amazon S3 cloud storage.
     $ @PROG@ anonymous set public s3/public-commons/images

  5. Set a custom prefix based bucket anonymous on Amazon S3 cloud storage using a JSON file.
     $ @PROG@ anonymous set-json /path/to/anonymous.json s3/public-commons/images 

  6. Get bucket permissions.
     $ @PROG@ anonymous get s3/shared

  7. Get bucket permissions in JSON format.
     $ @PROG@ anonymous get-json s3/shared

  8. List policies set to a specified bucket.
     $ @PROG@ anonymous list s3/shared

  9. List public object URLs recursively.
     $ @PROG@ anonymous --recursive links s3/shared/

=== help ilm tier edit
NAME:
  @PROG@ ilm tier edit - update an existing remote tier configuration

USAGE:
  @PROG@ ilm tier edit ALIAS NAME

NAME:
  Name of remote tier. e.g WARM-TIER

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
EXAMPLES:
  1. Update credentials for an existing Azure Blob Storage remote tier:
     $ @PROG@ ilm tier edit myminio AZTIER --account-key ACCOUNT-KEY

  2. Update credentials for an existing AWS S3 compatible remote tier:
     $ @PROG@ ilm tier edit myminio S3TIER --access-key ACCESS-KEY --secret-key SECRET-KEY

  3. Update credentials for an existing Google Cloud Storage remote tier:
     $ @PROG@ ilm tier edit myminio GCSTIER --credentials-file /path/to/credentials.json

  @PROG@ event remove - remove a bucket notification; '--force' removes all bucket notifications

USAGE:
  @PROG@ event remove TARGET [ARN] [FLAGS]

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
EXAMPLES:
  1. Remove bucket notification associated to a specific arn
    $ @PROG@ event remove myminio/mybucket arn:aws:sqs:us-west-2:444455556666:your-queue

  2. Remove all bucket notifications. --force flag is mandatory here
    $ @PROG@ event remove myminio/mybucket --force

=== flags event ls

--limit-upload value             limits uploads to a maximum rate in KiB/s, MiB/s, GiB/s. (default: unlimited) [$MC_LIMIT_UPLOAD]
--limit-download value           limits downloads to a maximum rate in KiB/s, MiB/s, GiB/s. (default: unlimited) [$MC_LIMIT_DOWNLOAD]
--custom-header value, -H value  add custom HTTP header to the request. 'key:value' format.
--help, -h                       show help

=== help replicate rm
NAME:
  @PROG@ replicate remove - remove a server side replication configuration rule

USAGE:
  @PROG@ replicate remove TARGET

FLAGS:
@FLAGS:2@
  
EXAMPLES:
  1. Remove replication configuration rule on bucket "mybucket" for alias "myminio" with rule id "bsib5mgt874bi56l0fmg".
     $ @PROG@ replicate remove --id "bsib5mgt874bi56l0fmg" myminio/mybucket

  2. Remove all the replication configuration rules on bucket "mybucket" for alias "myminio". --force flag is required.
     $ @PROG@ replicate remove --all --force myminio/mybucket
